arguments.sql: SELECT h.*, (SELECT count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") nlines FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL OR h."SRC_CD"='GL' AND h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT min("JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL') OR h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT min("JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='AP') OR h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "REF_JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH")

SELECT 'lines_no_header' k, count(*) c FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'header_no_lines', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_bad_acct', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" c WHERE c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'unbalanced_journals', count(*) FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_or_both_lines', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<0 OR "CR_AMT"<0 OR ("DR_AMT"<>0 AND "CR_AMT"<>0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_amt_lines', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT" IS NULL OR "CR_AMT" IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_vend', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_jrnl', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_bad_inv', count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'jh_bad_prd', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'jh_date_outside_prd', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'jh_post_in_closed_after_close', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."CLOSE_DT" IS NOT NULL AND h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'paid_inv_pay_mismatch', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."STAT_CD"='P' AND i."INV_AMT" <> (SELECT coalesce(sum("PAY_AMT"),0) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'open_inv_with_pay', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_inv_no_vend', count(*) FROM (SELECT "VEND_CD","INV_NO" FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_jrnl_no', count(*) FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_multi_pay', count(*) FROM (SELECT "INV_ID" FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_jrnl_shared', count(*) FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
